//: Security headers for Vercel hosting. Adjust the Content-Security-Policy to match the REAL host before deploy: connect-src must list every API origin the app actually calls (the Gemini/generativelanguage endpoint is included; add others as needed); style-src/font-src allow cdnjs.cloudflare.com because Tailwind/icons may be served from there - drop these if you self-host all assets.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; font-src https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com 'self'; script-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
